title: A clear conclusion becomes shared footing

captions.physics: Understanding structure and explaining its connections
captions.energy: Seeking clear grounds for shared understanding
captions.emotions: Feeling secure in an understandable structure

meaning: Your shared view can gain dependable footing when independent reflection becomes an explanation of structure that both people understand.
text: A stable shared view can grow from one carefully considered explanation. The Hermit in the physical position of Ajna suggests understanding a structure and sharing a clear conclusion. The Emperor in energy motivates seeking understandable grounds to draw on. The Emperor in emotions feels secure in the discovered structure. His first role concerns wanting to establish grounds; his second concerns experiencing dependability. Both of you may feel comfortable when the connections between parts are clear and no longer depend on who noticed them first.

Suppose you examine a drawing of a bookcase. After careful reflection, one person explains which lines show fastenings and which show shelf edges. **A clear personal conclusion can become shared footing.** You both now read the drawing as a connected structure. It feels pleasing that each element has an understandable place and the explanation can be expressed in your own words. This gives your shared view stability. One person noticed the connection first, but its substance is accessible to both without constantly returning to the original account.

The risk is confusing an explanation’s dependability with having to preserve one way of expressing it. Different wording feels disruptive although it conveys the same connection. Wanting understandable grounds distinguishes structure from familiar words: shared footing remains dependable when both can describe it independently.
